derived.description:
Description:
With a fierce demeanor and spear in hand, Tonowari is prepared to bravely lead his clan atop the powerful Skimwing.
This large deluxe set features a highly detailed 1.25-inch Tonowari action figure, articulated, poseable Skimwing, special world-builder stand, and bioluminescent effect when placed under black light.
Features:
Large deluxe World of Pandora set
Features a highly detailed, articulated Skimwing and Tonowari action figure
Includes special world-builder stand
Bioluminescent effect when placed under black light
Figure is showcased in Avatar Movie window box packaging
Collect all McFarlane Toys Avatar Movie products!
Includes: PLAYSET
Materials: PLASTIC
Ages: 8+
derived.title: McFarlane - Avatar: The Way of Water - World of Pandora - Tonowari & Skimwing
